race.description: Goulburn Carpet Court Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: CHEMTRAIL (1) has the strongest recent form after being beaten a nose in a BM66 at this track, and the stewards' notes around being steadied and having difficulty getting clear add merit to that effort. The drop into BM58 company and solid wet-track record make him the runner to beat. ZOUTEMPUS (3) resumes with two wins from three attempts at this track and distance. He's a fresh winner in the past too and if he handles the wet going, he'll be right in the mix. STEP QUICK (7) brings winning form from Gundagai on heavy ground. Has to be included on that effort. MUST BE SAIN (4) won't be far away if he can run up to his best.
